# Methods

```{r, message = F, echo = F}
raw_data <- read_csv(here("raw-data", "cohort.csv"))
df <- 
    raw_data |> 
    mutate(
        smoke = factor(smoke, 
                       levels = c(0,1), 
                       labels = c("no", "yes")), 
        female = factor(female, 
                        levels = c(0,1), 
                        labels = c("no", "yes")), 
        cardiac = factor(cardiac, 
                         levels = c(1,0), 
                         labels = c("cardiac event", "no cardiac event"))
    ) |> 
    mutate(
        age_cat = case_when(
        age < 30 ~ "18-29", 
        age >= 30 & age < 50 ~ "30-49", 
        age >= 50 ~ "50+", 
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))
```

```{r, message = F}
df |> 
    tbl_summary(
        statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})")
    )
```

**Study Population.**
```{r, echo = F}
n_total = nrow(raw_data)
n_female = sum(raw_data$female)
p_female = round((n_female/n_total)*100, 0)
n_smoker = sum(raw_data$smoke)
p_smoker = round((n_smoker/n_total)*100, 0)
mean_age = round(mean(raw_data$age), 0)
mean_cost = round(mean(raw_data$cost), 0)

```


Our study sample contains `{r} n_total` individuals, `{r} p_smoker`% of which are female, `{r} p_smoker`% are smokers. The mean age is `{r} mean_age`. The average cost of health care is $`{r} mean_cost` per year.

**Outcome.**

**Exposures.**

**Statistical Analysis.**

We ran a generalized linear regression to assess the relationship of `age` and `cost`, adjusting for `female`, `smoke`, and `cardiac`. `age` was categorized into three groups: 18-29, 30-49, and 50+ for better visualization and interpretability.

# Results
From our linear model, we see that age is a significant and positive predictor of `cost` and that individuals in older age groups are more likely to pay more `cost` than younger age groups (on average, there seems to be \~200-300 increase in `cost` per age group). Figure 1 shows the distribution of `cost` by `age_cat`.

```{r}
fig1 <- 
    df |> 
    ggplot() + 
    geom_boxplot(aes(x = age_cat, y = cost, color = age_cat, fill = age_cat), 
                 alpha = 0.2) + 
    labs(x = "Age Category (years)", 
         y = "Cost (dollars)", 
         color = NULL, fill = NULL) 
```
